summary: Independent security review plus an orchestrating-agent pass. Four findings, all fixed and re-verified on this tree: HIGH the image would have shipped the synthetic demo (untracked apps/web/.env + build-time inlining) — fixed three ways and confirmed by an A/B build; MEDIUM runner wrote synced material without a traversal guard; MEDIUM first invited student could land in #teachers; LOW gated check shared smoke port. Verified-clean list covers allowlist bypasses, timing-safe comparison, token scoping across all four WS combinations, token leakage, a ten-way invite race, role escalation, static traversal, fail-closed claim, .dockerignore depth and re-seed token preservation. No contradictions with D-001..D-006.
